grader.scenario: Home move broadband activation delayed by two weeks; agent blames Openreach

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net customer services' and closing 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' properly stated.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Two managed holds announced ('Bear with me for a couple of minutes', 'Give me a moment') and properly thanked without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified address and 4-digit security PIN within 37 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Addressed Brenda by name naturally throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer had two outbursts at [01:03] and [05:23]. Agent acknowledged both warmly (at [01:24]: 'I completely understand how difficult and stressful it is moving into a new home and having no broadband for your family' and at [05:47]: 'I completely understand how exasperating and unfair that is, Brenda, especially taking unpaid leave and waiting in for an engineer who failed to knock on your door').

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent arranged priority dispatch of an unlimited 4G backup router, froze billing, and scheduled a personal progress callback for Friday.
